texts: The Cold Sea stretches north of the cliffs.
The Cold Sea is grey-green in summer.
The Cold Sea is slate-grey in winter.
The fishing boats stay near the inlet.
The cold-threshold wind comes off the Cold Sea.

fields.sentence: The Cold Sea stretches north of the cliffs.

review.notes: 'north of' is a non-containment multi-word preposition, so the CamelCase-joined entity-attached head NorthOf is licensed by the same open licence as NextTo / AcrossTheLaneFrom, and 'stretches' correctly mints no event under the bare-position-clause rule; the definite plural 'the cliffs' rightly becomes a group witness.

fields.sentence: The Cold Sea is grey-green in summer.

q2_gaps: SEASONS as time points: the Time-term inventory is Year / Month / Day / Weekday / Hour / Minute, and seasons appear only as DEICTIC constants ("last_spring", "next_summer"); a bare non-deictic "in summer" has no stated term or bare-symbol licence, so (Time e summer) is an unlicensed extension of the day-part convention.

A RECURRING/seasonal restriction on a copular claim about an individual: the copular-with-time-modifier rule mandates the flat dual-emit half, which here asserts (Member cold_sea grey_green) unrestrictedly and so widens the claim past what the sentence says, while ConditionalProperty — the mechanism for a restricted property — takes a KIND in its first slot and is unavailable for a named individual.
review.notes: The multi-word name is correctly one opaque symbol with its in-name kind atom and no "cold" modifier genus, and the reify-plus-flat shape follows the copular-with-time-modifier rule as written. Minor: the state witness is sk_greygreen_1 rather than sk_grey_green_1, so its stem does not match the class symbol.

fields.sentence: The Cold Sea is slate-grey in winter.

q2_gaps: a bare non-deictic season as a Time filler ('in winter') — the Time section defines structured terms (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute), speech-anchored deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer), and day-part bare symbols, but gives no form for a generic, non-deictic season

a hyphenated adjectival compound whose head is an ADJECTIVE ('slate-grey') — Compound concepts licenses the genus atom for a modifier_noun compound whose last word is a real head noun, and explicitly leaves adjective compounds opaque, so (Inheritance slate_grey grey) is an extrapolation from the solid/hyphenated-spelling boundary note

a condition- or season-scoped property of an INDIVIDUAL — ConditionalProperty takes a kind in its first slot, so the restriction can only ride the reified state's Time atom while the mandated flat copular dual-emit asserts the property unrestricted
review.notes: The copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit (reified state + Experiencer + Time + flat copular atom, no tense) is applied exactly as specified, and 'Cold' correctly stays inside the capitalized name run with no (Member cold_sea cold). The state witness sk_slategrey_1 drops the class symbol's internal underscore (sk_slate_grey_1 is the mechanical form) — cosmetic, meaning unaffected.

fields.sentence: The fishing boats stay near the inlet.

q2_gaps: 'stay / remain' + locative PP: the continuative component ('stay near' is not merely 'be near') has no carrier once the clause is routed to the position-atom form — the instruction set registers this as a gap to record rather than encode

a stative position predicate over a definite plural group: the set does not say whether a group-level position atom accompanies the per-member distribution rule (the event-side doctrine keeps group event plus rule, while the resultative/copular doctrine bars the group-symbol atom)
review.notes: fishing_boat is fused with its genus only and no modifier genus, which is correct for a noun modifier, and the rule's (STV 1.0 0.9) matches the plain-plural distribution convention. The parse emits only the per-member rule with no group-level (Near sk_group_1 ...) atom — defensible under the bar on predicating member states of the group symbol.

fields.sentence: The cold-threshold wind comes off the Cold Sea.

review.notes: "off" is licensed as Source by the motion-path rule; a wind is a gas, so the intransitive natural-force subject correctly takes Patient, and the kind word inside "Cold Sea" licenses (Member cold_sea sea). Noun modifier "cold-threshold" correctly gets no modifier genus, head genus emitted.
